preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 2*10**5 for N in Ns)
preconditions.description: Length of each string N is between 1 and 2*10^5.
Each string S consists of lowercase English alphabets only.
The total length of all strings does not exceed 2*10^5.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i] == min_lexicographical_string(Ss[i]) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Each output line is the lexicographically smallest string obtainable from the corresponding input string.
